test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Feb 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word to fill in the blank.

Only one of his proposals was __accepted __in the meeting, while others were ______.
solution:
The correct answer is "**rejected**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Accepted**" generally means to receive something willingly. (स्वीकार करना) 

 
 
• **Example**- His proposal was widely accepted by the management.
 
 
 
• "**Rejected**" means to refuse to accept, consider, or allow. (अस्वीकार करना)
 
 
• **Example**- The proposal was rejected due to budget constraints.
 
 
 
• Hence, the option that is opposite in meaning to the given word is "rejected".

Therefore, the correct answer is '**option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let's have a look at the meanings of the remaining options.
 
• "**Fulfilled**" signifies having achieved or realized something desired, promised, or predicted. (पूरा करना)
 
• "**Attended**" means to go to or be present at. (उपस्थित होना)
 
• "**Agreed**" stands for having the same opinion about something; concurring. (सहमत होना)
